pages.title: Temperature Constant
pages.text: §lMax Level:§r I$(br2)§lApplicable to:§r Any armor piece$(br2)§lEffect:§r Works while any worn armor piece has this enchantment: immune to freezing (powder snow) and to fire, lava, and hot block damage, and frozen ticks are continuously cleared.$(br2)§lConflicts:§r None$(br2)§lObtained via:§r Enchanting table, loot chests, villager trades
